answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonding each identity in a distinct escrow: when k coordinated identities equivocate, evidence links them and penalties apply across the binomial(k,2) correlated pairs, scaling as O(k²). A per-pair multiplicative haircut compounds in the vault, so a swarm faces an exponential penalty multiplier upon detection; splitting stake across aliases does not dilute the shared loss. Like a reef guarding a wharf, the rule makes coordination costly rather than merely counting names.
